text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Surge in 5xx responses on edge gateway route /v1/generate detected at 2026-03-15T19:30:00Z. Error rate > 7% over 1m, paging on-call: @maya. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gateway-5xx

maya: acked. pulling up dashboards now. any customer impact reports?

jonathan: seeing upstream provider-x latency spikes and HTTP 502s starting ~19:28Z. correlates with a provider-side quota bump. sample from edge logs:
```
2026-03-15T19:29:12Z edge-01 POST /v1/generate 502 backend="provider-x" latency=120ms
2026-03-15T19:29:13Z edge-02 POST /v1/generate 502 backend="provider-x" latency=350ms
2026-03-15T19:29:14Z edge-03 POST /v1/generate 502 backend="provider-x" latency=410ms
```

rachel: likely an upstream failure cascade. two levers: 1) route traffic away from provider-x to provider-y/fallback model variant 2) temporary threshold/ suppression to reduce noise while we mitigate.

maya: doing 1) now — enabling fallback routing policy for model-serving-route in routing-config. will throttle fanout to provider-x.

maya: command i ran:
```bash
# switch route to fallback-model for new requests
redwoodctl routes update --route model-serving-route --policy fallback-first --duration 10m --reason "mitigate provider-x 502s"
```

infra-bot: autoscaler: +2 nodes added to serving-pool-1 (scale-up requested by maya). new capacity should take ~60s.

oncall-sre: suppressing noisy alert rule alert:High5xxRate (1m) for 15m while we stabilize. created ticket INC-4821 to track tuning.

jonathan: after routing change, 5xx rate dropped to ~1.2% in next 2m. some requests still get gateway timeouts (504) from provider-x for in-flight retries. we should tune upstream retry/backoff settings to avoid amplifying load.

rachel: agreed. propose: reduce retries to 1 for provider-x, add exponential backoff with jitter, and add circuit-breaker when 5xx > 5% for 30s. also add a service-level dashboard tile for provider-x error distribution.

maya: logging suggested rule change here for follow-up PR:
```yaml
# prometheus alert (proposal)
- alert: GatewayHigh5xxRate
  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="edge",route="/v1/generate",status=~"5.."}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="edge",route="/v1/generate"}[1m])) > 0.05
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Edge /v1/generate 5xx ratio > 5% for 2m"
    runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gateway-5xx
```

oncall-sre: notes on tuning — raised threshold to 5% with 2m duration for paging (instead of 1m/3%). added a separate 1m low-severity alert to dashboard only (no paging) for visibility. created dashboard: Dash / Edge -> Gateway 5xx, + provider-x breakdown.

jonathan: filed infra change to reduce provider-x retries: PR #3248 (internal). also added request-level tagging to help trace which upstream served a request.

maya: customer-impact: flagged two production customers with elevated error counts (~10 failed requests each) — ops-notify sent to customer-success. no broad outage.

rachel: follow-up actions for post-incident:
- owner: rachel (postmortem)
- timeline + root-cause: provider-x transient quota/latency spike + our retry amplification
- actions: route-fallback automation, circuit-breaker/backoff defaults, alert-threshold update, dashboard tile, runbook update (include upstream retry guidance)
- ticket: INC-4821, follow-up tasks in ENGOPS-2210

oncall-sre: created short runbook addendum and assigned PR to maya for routing rollback tests. scheduled 30m follow-up meeting at 20:15Z.

maya: closing paging now — will monitor for 30m, leaving fallback routing in place until we confirm provider-x stable. thanks all :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident resolved: overall 5xx back to baseline (<1%) at 2026-03-15T19:41:00Z. summary posted to #incidents and INC-4821 updated.

maya: posting a short blameless postmortem draft in the channel after monitoring window.
